description: ADO-CURSOR same-connection visibility on a read/write Connection: a server keyset, a server static and a client static read-only Recordset of SELECT ID, S FROM T ORDER BY ID are opened and read (RecordCount); then, through the same Connection, UPDATE S of ID 1, INSERT a row and DELETE ID 2 (Errors); each Recordset is read again from MoveFirst without refresh (rows, RecordCount), then Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncAllValues) and read, then Requery and read. Asks which cursors show the connection's own update, insert and delete when, and which refresh calls each accepts.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
